{"action":"done","summary":"Specification phase complete. Created/updated spec.md at /testbed/specs/001-transactions/spec.md for the TaggedCache milestone. The spec contains:

- 5 user stories (P1-P3) covering insertion/retrieval, tag invalidation, LRU eviction with tag integrity, input validation, and maxsize validation
- 16 functional requirements (FR-001 through FR-016) covering all aspects of R01-R03
- 6 measurable success criteria (SC-001 through SC-006)
- 7 documented assumptions
- 0 [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers

Quality checklist at /testbed/specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md: all 14 items passed on first review.

No extension hooks present. feature.json written to /testbed/.specify/feature.json.

The spec is ready for $speckit-plan or $speckit-tasks.","claims":{"schema_version":"1.0","claims":[{"id":"R01","text":"put(key,value,tags=()) inserts/replaces an entry. get(key) returns a detached deep copy or raises KeyError for missing keys. Values are copied on input too. Keys are hashable. Tags must be a finite iterable of strings; deduplicate tags. Reject a bare string as tags and nonstring tag entries with ValueError, before changing existing state.","kind":"requirement","status":"planned","boundary":["specify"],"depends_on":[],"conflicts_with":[],"falsification_tests":["c.put('a',1,'x') should raise ValueError and leave cache empty","c.put('a',1,['x',42]) should raise ValueError and leave cache empty","c.get('missing') should raise KeyError","c.get('a') after c.put('a',[1,2]) should return a deep copy independent of original"],"source_ref":"milestone requirement R01","uncertainty":"low","evidence":[]},{"id":"R02","text":"invalidate(tag) removes exactly currently cached entries carrying that tag and returns the number removed. Replacing a key removes its old tag memberships. LRU eviction must not leave stale memberships affecting later reuse of the same key. get refreshes LRU recency. len(cache) counts live entries.","kind":"requirement","status":"planned","boundary":["specify"],"depends_on":["R01"],"conflicts_with":[],"falsification_tests":["c.put('a',1,['x']);c.put('b',2,['x']);c.invalidate('x') returns 2","c.put('a',1,['old']);c.put('a',2,['new']);c.invalidate('old') returns 0","After LRU eviction of key 'a' tagged 'x', c.invalidate('x') returns 0","c.get('a') after eviction of other entry must refresh recency of 'a'"],"source_ref":"milestone requirement R02","uncertainty":"low","evidence":[]},{"id":"R03","text":"maxsize must be a positive integer, excluding bool. Invalid replacement input must leave the old value/tags/recency unchanged. Values cost one capacity slot regardless of object size.","kind":"requirement","status":"planned","boundary":["specify"],"depends_on":["R01"],"conflicts_with":[],"falsification_tests":["TaggedCache(maxsize=True) should raise ValueError","c.maxsize = -1 should raise ValueError and leave maxsize unchanged","TaggedCache(0) should raise ValueError","Each value costs 1 capacity slot regardless of object size"],"source_ref":"milestone requirement R03","uncertainty":"low","evidence":[]}]}
}
